mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, the current temperature is 49 degrees with clear skies at the Verona Public Library and a new moon phase visible tonight. The temperature will drop to an overnight low of 36 degrees, and there is no rain predicted for the evening.

The City of Verona has announced that pavement repair work will take place on November 10 and 11. No parking signs will be placed on several streets, including portions of Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street, between 7 AM and 7 PM during these repairs.

There is plenty to do in our community. We have live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, or participate in various trivia nights and live music performances at Hop Haus, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company this coming Wednesday.

In a report from October 25, Verona police officers arrested a 40-year-old man for a first offence O W I after he was discovered passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor is the fan-favorite Snickers Swirl. The restaurant is currently open to serve you and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
